name: update_event
description: Update an existing Google Calendar event.

event_id.description: ID of the event to update.

start.description: New start time in RFC3339 format or date for all-day events.

end.description: New end time in RFC3339 format or date for all-day events.

attendees.description: Comma-separated list of attendee email addresses (e.g. 'alice@example.com, bob@example.com'). Pass 'none' to remove all attendees. Omit this parameter entirely to leave attendees unchanged. An empty string is an error.

calendar_id.description: Optional ID of the calendar to use. Usually a person's email address (for a shared or colleague calendar). Use list_calendars to see the available calendar IDs. Defaults to the configured calendar if not provided.
